Bug Description: Unexpected revert of queued actions
Comment: Property violated: independentQueuedActions. Technical mechanism is S2-3-like, but primary Web3Bugs label is O1.

Bug Description: Impossible to queue two similar actions
Comment: Duplicate-action rejection is treated by AAVE as an accepted design constraint/workaround case.

Bug Description: Unexpected action occurrence upon low-level call
Comment: Low-level-call behavior is L8-like technically, but AAVE identifies a legitimate intended use case; primary label O6.

Bug Description: Rescuing underlying AAVE from StakedTokenV2Rev4 can undercollateralize stkAAVE
Comment: Governance-controlled upgrade/rescue flow; technical property StkAaveIsBackedByAave has S6-4 intent. Final code adds the collateralization check.

Bug Description: Rescuing AAVE and LEND from LendToAaveMigrator can leave remaining LEND undercollateralized
Comment: Governance-controlled upgrade/rescue flow; technical property LendIsBackedByAave has S6-4 intent.

Bug Description: Burnt-LEND miscount can understate the AAVE collateral required by the migrator
Comment: Governance-controlled upgrade/rescue flow. Technical root cause is S6-3-like incorrect accounting input, while the detecting backing property has S6-4 intent.

Bug Description: Indefinite extension of unstake window
Comment: The report ties the historical finding to its former Property #17 cooldownCorrectness. The active source rule with that name has materially different assertions, so its result is not inherited by the active catalog example.

Bug Description: Deserved rewards of users changed as a result of configureAssets
Comment: configureAssets is restricted to EMISSION_MANAGER in the supplied implementation; the report describes the reward-index/accounting effect of that trusted configuration action. Finding label is kept separate from active property labels.

Bug Description: First depositor attack caused by rounding errors
Comment: The report explicitly attributes the issue to rounding errors and names returnFundsDecreaseExchangeRate as the broken property.

Bug Description: Exchange rate can become zero and cause general DoS
Comment: The report describes returnFunds in a zero-share state producing a zero exchange rate; exchangeRateNeverZero is the named violated property.

Bug Description: Exchange rate increased by calling returnFunds with zero amount
Comment: The report names returnFundsDecreaseExchangeRate; the technical property checks the direction of an accounting conversion state update.

Bug Description: Exchange rate changed by slash with zero amount
Comment: slash is restricted by onlySlashingAdmin, so the final finding is O1 under the dataset taxonomy; the report explicitly attributes the technical mechanism to rounding up in _getExchangeRate (L2-like root cause), while the detecting property has S6-4 intent.

Bug Description: Token address duplicates not checked on calling initialize
Comment: Property shouldRevertInitializeTokens has S2-3 intent; final finding is O1 because duplicate configuration is introduced by the trusted governance/initializer role.

Bug Description: Front running of withdrawal can choose the token form paid to the redeemer
Comment: The L2-to-L1 payload omitted toUnderlyingAsset, allowing an unprivileged caller to choose that argument. No source property is explicitly named for this issue.

Bug Description: Transformation from dynamic to static amounts is not precisely reversible
Comment: The report attributes this to ray-math rounding and names dynamicToStaticInversible2 and cancelAfterDepositGivesBackExactAmount.

Bug Description: Cancelling a deposit does not check for success of deposit on L2
Comment: The report names cannotCancelDepositAndGainBothTokens. Aave explicitly treats timely Starknet proof availability as a bridge assumption; technical detector intent is S4-1.

Bug Description: Unregistered reward can make StaticATokenLM overstate a user's reward entitlement
Comment: Report issue #1. The detecting property getClaimableRewards_stable has S6-4 intent; the finding root cause is lack of validation that the user-supplied reward address is registered. PR #29 added explicit registered-reward validation.

Bug Description: A deposit can lose one share worth of assets because transfer and share minting round differently
Comment: Report issue #2, broken Property #14 withdrawCheck; selected source does not contain that property.

Bug Description: deposit() can violate EIP-4626 by accepting a rounded-to-zero deposit without reverting
Comment: Report issue #3, broken Properties #11/#12 depositCheck variants; those properties are absent from the selected source.

Bug Description: getUnclaimedRewards() returned a value in inconsistent units
Comment: Report issue #4. rewardsConsistencyWhenInsufficientRewards has S6-4 accounting-conservation and S6-2 getter-semantic relationships; the finding label is S6-2 because the concrete bug is a return-value unit mismatch.

Bug Description: totalAssets() and maxWithdraw() can theoretically revert on multiplication overflow for extreme inputs
Comment: Report issue #5, tied to Properties #21/#26 not present in selected source; report treats the case as purely theoretical for current tokens.
